messages:
laura_ml: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a 11.8% drop in the summarization promptset for the new rtx-quantized model. Failing examples show truncated summaries and literal backslash-n sequences in the middle of sentences.

laura_ml: sample from nightly: ```
Input: Article about product launch...
Gen: "We launched our product. \n\n It was..."  <-- literal \\n in output, then generator stops mid-sentence.```

sasha: who owns the tokenizer/serialization bump this week? any PRs touched token map or escape handling?

tim_infra: deploy-bot shows a small tokenizer lib upgrade merged yesterday (pkg/tokenize v2.1). Deployed to staging at 02:15 UTC.

deploy-bot: ticket #4321 merged: "tokenize: normalize-newlines -> escape-unified" by @akshay. Deployed to staging (sha: a1b2c3).

akshay: that PR changed how newline groups are collapsed: we went from treating "\n\n" as paragraph break to normalizing and emitting explicit "\\n" tokens instead of preserving raw newline token boundaries. It was intended to make HTML->text pipelines consistent.

sasha: can you repro locally with the quantized model + v2.1 tokenizer? want minimal example for root cause.

laura_ml: repro steps: 1) load quantized model from artifact q/model-v3-rtx. 2) use tokenizer v2.1. 3) run generation on summarization prompt batch. I attached a tiny repro (pasted above).

akshay: running now — quick note: the runtime's streaming code expects an empty-token separator for newline groups when building KV-cache slices. With v2.1 we now emit explicit "\\n" tokens which the runtime treats as content and slots into prefix cache, causing early termination logic to trigger (we check for two consecutive sentence-end tokens to stop). So it's a combined tokenizer + runtime stop-condition mismatch.

jordan: aha — not just tokenization, the stop-condition is brittle. That explains truncation. The literal backslash-n appearing is because de-escaping happens later in the pipeline, but generation is using pre-deescaped tokens as content.

sasha: severity? is this only on summarization promptset or wider?

laura_ml: nightly shows summarization hit worst (11.8%), chat flows minor uptick in truncation (2.3%), embeddings unaffected. Pattern: prompts with multi-paragraph inputs.

akshay: root cause hypothesis (short): tokenizer v2.1 changes newline normalization -> emits explicit escape tokens -> runtime stop-condition treats those as sentence-end triggers -> generation truncates; plus de-escape step delayed so outputs contain literal \\n in text.

laura_ml: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) rollback tokenizer to v2.0 on staging and prod canary for inference traffic, 2) add gating rule to nightly eval to fail builds that increase paragraph-truncation metric >3%, 3) patch runtime stop-condition to only stop on token ids flagged as end-of-sentence by model vocab, not by textual pattern, 4) add a small shim to de-escape before stop-check while we roll runtime patch.

tim_infra: I'll schedule rollback to v2.0 for canary (prod small pool) in the next 30m. Will post deploy window.

jordan: for longer term: update model onboarding checklist: (a) run multi-paragraph prompt clusters, (b) verify tokenizer->runtime semantics (stop tokens, KV placement), (c) include de-escape unit in streaming pipeline.

sasha: can we add a temporary gating rule in CI/nightly that rejects tokenizer bumps unless they include a compatibility note for runtime stop logic?

akshay: will open PR to change tokenizer behavior to emit the previous newline marker id instead and add compatibility flag. ETA for patch: ~4h.

laura_ml: ACTIONS (short):
- laura_ml: collect top 10 failing prompts and attach to incident ticket #4892 (done).
- tim_infra: rollback tokenizer v2.1 to v2.0 in prod canary (in progress).
- akshay: push tokenizer patch & compat flag, and add unit tests for newline handling (ETA 4h).
- j jordan: runtime change proposal to be reviewed tomorrow (only stop on model eos id).
- sasha: update nightly eval gating to include paragraph-truncation threshold (done, patch queued).

laura_ml: I'll run a follow-up nightly after the rollback & patch to confirm the summarization metric returns to baseline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
